description: Do x402 listings like mine survive? One signed number: the share of new Bazaar listings in your category, price band and method (GET or POST) still listed four weeks after they first appeared, pooled over recent weeks, with a 95% range and the sample size. When too few listings match, filters drop in a fixed order and the answer says which held. Unchanged answers asked with their ETag are a free 304. Price: $0.002 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges $0.002 to it. Failed calls aren't charged.

if_none_match.description: Send the answer's ETag back in If-None-Match (over MCP, the if_none_match argument): while the answer is unchanged it comes back as a free 304 Not Modified.
if_none_match.title: If None Match

kyapay-token.description: A Skyfire pay or kya-pay token made for Agoranome's service, from a client that can't set the kyapay-token header. Leave it out when paying with x402 or the header.
